name: Healing Days ~Toshi no Sa Kanojo to no Ama Ama Seikatsu~
original_name: ヒーリング・デイズ〜年の差彼女との甘々生活〜
source:
The protagonist (name customizable) is a salaryman working in a provincial city.
One day, after a work-related mishap, he drowns his sorrows in alcohol and passes out on the street.
When he wakes up, he finds himself in an unfamiliar living room, being cared for by the heroine, Uesaka Shiori.
Shiori had taken pity on him after finding him passed out on the street and brought him home.
Touched by her kindness, the protagonist begins to pursue her. Shiori doesn't seem entirely opposed, but...
And so begins a sweet, slightly unconventional romance with an older girlfriend.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013575.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公（姓名可自定义）是一名在地方城市工作的上班族。
一天，他因工作出了差错而借酒浇愁，最后醉倒在路边。
醒来后，他发现自己躺在陌生的客厅里，女主角上坂栞正在照顾自己。
原来，栞发现他昏倒在路边，心生怜悯，便将他带回了家。
被她的温柔所打动，主人公开始追求她。栞似乎也并非完全不愿意，但是……
于是，一段与年长女友之间甜蜜又稍显特别的恋情，就此展开。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013575.html/]DLsite[/url]]
